notes: Pyre 1.2.1 — the reliability release. Lorebooks now ALWAYS reach the model (fixed silent drops with SillyTavern-imported presets, bindings added after a chat existed, shared worlds never auto-linking, and per-chat overrides being ignored), plus a live 'Lore active: N of M entries' auditor in Chat info. Character system prompts, post-history instructions, and persona dialogue examples now actually reach the model too. Import your own exported chats back (full-fidelity JSON or JSONL), export cards as standard JSON, pin providers for quick in-chat swapping, relocate your data folder for Syncthing (PYRE_DATA_DIR), a self-contained Linux tarball, and a full-app audit's worth of layout, boot, and data-integrity fixes.
